$comment: This deployment uses ONE GITHUB REPOSITORY PER SYSTEM, not a monorepo.
A push to a system's repository deploys the system(s) mapped to it, decided
by the 'repos' table below, and a webhook must be added on each repository.
'repos' maps a system to its GitHub repository:
key   = a system id ('real:dental') or a bare slug ('dental', which
applies to BOTH trees) — the more specific key wins.
A system with no entry here is NEVER deployed by a webhook; it can only be
reached by the manual admin action. That is the safe default.
'watchPaths' default sensibly and normally need no entry.
NOTE ON DEMOS: the demo trees (demo-systems/<slug>) are a DIFFERENT
codebase from the real trees (system/<slug>), not a copy of them, so a demo
must not share its repo with the real system of the same slug — a demo push
would otherwise deploy to a customer. Demo repositories must be separate
and are left unmapped until they exist (see docs/DEPLOY-GIT.md).
